Hi Sarah — happy to jump in with the technical plan. Short answers first:
- Yes: our client SDK supports streaming (server-sent events / chunked JSON) and exposes a streaming iterator in the SDK (examples below).
- Tool-calling: Redwood supports deterministic function/tool calling. You can either implement an HTTP adapter (we call your endpoint with a signed header) or use a local mock endpoint during test. Auth headers are forwarded as configured in the integration policy (we recommend short-lived HMAC tokens).

High-level integration steps (SNAP):
1) Install SDK: npm install @redwood/inference (node) or pip install redwood-inference (python)
2) Auth: create a staging API key in console (we can create a short-lived key for you)
3) Chat route (example):
   - SDK call: const stream = redwood.chat.stream({ model: 'gpt-redwood-v1', input: prompt, session_id: 'acme-session-01' })
   - Read loop: for await (const chunk of stream) { render(chunk.text) }
4) Tool calling: declare tools in your adapter config. Example JSON declaration: [name: "ticket_lookup", endpoint: "https://acme-staging.ticket/api/lookup", auth: "hmac-v1"]
   - Redwood will validate tool output against a JSON schema if you provide one.
5) Observability: enable request tracing and token-level logs in the console; we’ll provide a recommended tracing config for your telemetry backend.

Performance notes:
- Default rate limits for POC keys: 20 rps with burst to 50 for short tests.
- Expect first-token latency ~200–600ms depending on sequence length and model. We’ll provide a perf profile for your workload during Week 2.

Deliverables we'll provide this week:
- Integration checklist and sample code (attached)
- SOW draft (sow-draft.docx)
- Security questionnaire (we can fill the acme-security-questions.xlsx; please share the sheet)

Proposed tasks & owners (week-by-week):
- Onboarding & creds (by Nov 13): Marissa + Acme eng admin (Luis) — action: provide staging creds
- SDK install & sample route (Nov 15–17): Dev (Redwood) + Luis (Acme) — action: implement simple chat route and confirm streaming behavior
- Tool-calling adapter (Nov 18–23): Acme engs (Luis) + Redwood SE (Dev) — action: implement adapter and example schema
- Load test & evaluation (Nov 24–Dec 3): Acme QA + Redwood SE — action: run 5k synthetic queries + rating collection

Can we lock a 30-min kickoff on Nov 15 10:00 AM PST? I’ll include a short demo of the streaming flow and hand off the SOW.
